package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func (client Client) GetNextAction(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(studentID)
	if err != nil || parsed.String() != studentID {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpointWithToken("/internal/students/"+url.PathEscape(studentID)+"/next-action", client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
	}
	if !studentJSONMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumLearningWorkspaceResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil || len(contents) > maximumLearningWorkspaceResponseBytes {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	}
	var action domain.TeacherNextAction
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&action); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	}
	// Zero versions are valid without a path, but omitted versions are corrupt.
	// Decode presence separately so neither Teacher nor UI invents provenance.
	var required struct {
		SourceVersions *struct {
			ContextVersion *int64 `json:"context_version"`
			PathVersion    *int64 `json:"path_version"`
		} `json:"source_versions"`
		Primary *struct {
			Target *json.RawMessage `json:"target"`
		} `json:"primary"`
		SecondaryActions []struct {
			Target *json.RawMessage `json:"target"`
		} `json:"secondary_actions"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(contents, &required); err != nil || required.SourceVersions == nil || required.SourceVersions.ContextVersion == nil || required.SourceVersions.PathVersion == nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	}
	if required.Primary != nil && required.Primary.Target == nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
	}
	for _, choice := range required.SecondaryActions {
		if choice.Target == nil {
			return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
		}
	}
	action, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherNextAction(action)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	return action, nil
}
